issues.t: CVT can wear and lose speed (service campaign JSD)
issues.sym: Check engine light, and the car may lose speed and only drive up to about 37 mph. Some owners noticed harsh shifts or odd engine revs.
issues.why: Toyota found the CVT control software could make a part inside the transmission cycle more than needed and wear early. Its service campaign, which may be covered for your car, updates the software, checks the CVT solenoid, and replaces the valve body or whole CVT if needed.
issues.next: Give your VIN to a Toyota dealer and ask whether campaign JSD (which replaced J0D) was done. If the check engine light is on with CVT symptoms, get it checked before long drives.

issues.t: CVT hesitation, slipping or sudden loss of power
issues.sym: A delay of a second or two when pulling away, engine revs flaring before the car picks up speed, a sudden RPM drop at highway speed, or loss of power while accelerating.
issues.why: Owners report slow response and slipping from the CVT. Some cases trace to the software and wear problem fixed by Toyota's CVT campaign; others need the transmission repaired or replaced.
issues.next: If the car loses power in traffic, move to a safe spot and get it checked soon. Ask a Toyota dealer to check for campaign JSD and stored transmission codes first.

issues.t: High-pitched whine from the CVT once warmed up
issues.sym: A high hiss or whine from the transmission that shows up after the car reaches normal temperature.
issues.why: Toyota traced it to a plate in the CVT's valve body. Bulletins cover the 2016 Scion iM and 2017–2018 Corolla iM.
issues.next: Not an emergency, but have a Toyota dealer confirm it and check the CVT serial number against the bulletin. Mention bulletin S-SB-0001-19 or T-SB-0016-19.

issues.t: Check engine light with code P2820
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P2820 (CVT pressure control solenoid). The car may lose speed.
issues.why: Toyota updated the engine computer logic to stop this fault. Under the CVT campaign, cars that already have P2820 get a new transmission.
issues.next: Have the code read at a Toyota dealer and ask about bulletin S-SB-0002-18 and campaign JSD. Avoid long trips until it's checked.

issues.t: Check engine light with code P2610
issues.sym: Check engine light with code P2610 (engine-off timer). The car usually drives normally.
issues.why: An engine computer logic issue can set this code. Toyota released updated software.
issues.next: Not urgent. Ask a Toyota dealer to check for bulletin S-SB-0001-18 and update the software.

issues.sym: A grinding or groaning sound from the front when you press the brakes, even with plenty of pad left.
issues.why: Toyota released an updated front brake pad kit for this noise.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected so a real problem isn't missed, and ask for the updated pads from bulletin S-SB-0002-19.

issues.t: Water on the floor from a clogged A/C drain
issues.sym: Wet carpet on the passenger side, or water dripping under the dash when the A/C runs.
issues.why: The tube that drains condensation from the A/C can clog, so water backs up into the cabin.
issues.next: Have the drain cleared and dry the carpet fully to prevent mold and musty smells.

issues.t: Musty smell after water gets inside
issues.sym: A damp, musty or moldy smell in the cabin, often after a leak or wet carpet.
issues.why: Water that gets under the carpet soaks the padding and sound deadener. Toyota has a bulletin covering the iM that explains how to find the leak and clean up the floor.
issues.next: Find and fix the water leak first. Then ask a dealer about bulletin T-SB-0094-21; the cleanup involves removing seats and carpet.

issues.t: Horn stops working (steering wheel spiral cable)
issues.sym: The horn works only some of the time, then stops completely. Steering wheel buttons may act up too.
issues.why: The spiral cable (clock spring) behind the steering wheel carries power to the horn and airbag. Owners report it failing.
issues.next: Get it fixed soon; a working horn is a safety item. Have the airbag light checked at the same time.

issues.t: Pre-collision system warning or several warning lights at once
issues.sym: A pre-collision system malfunction message, sometimes with headlight, ABS, brake or traction control warnings.
issues.why: Owners report the forward camera system and related warnings acting up, sometimes after brake or front-end work. A sensor, wiring fault or camera aim problem can set them off.
issues.next: Treat the safety systems as off until it's checked. Have the codes read; the camera may need recalibration after windshield or front-end work.

issues.sym: No symptom. The door-jamb label may list too high a carrying capacity.
issues.why: The label didn't account for the weight of dealer-installed accessories, so the car could be overloaded.
issues.next: Check with a Toyota dealer whether recall 16V236 was done; a corrected label is free.

issues.sym: No warning. The temporary spare may be low on air when you need it.
issues.why: Some cars sold through Gulf States Toyota had spare tires that weren't filled to the pressure on the tire label.
issues.next: Check the spare's pressure yourself, and ask a Toyota dealer whether recall 17V295 applies to your car.
